blocks.text: Penicillin bactericidal (bacteria ko maarne wali) antibiotics ka aik group hai jo Penicillium fungi (phaphoond) se hasil hota hai. Yeh bacteria ki cell wall banne (synthesis) ko rok kar mukhtalif bacterial infections ka ilaaj karta hai. Ise Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein daryaft kiya. Yeh gram-positive bacteria ke khilaf bohat mo'assar hai, jin mein streptococcal aur staphylococcal infections shamil hain. Penicillin ke aam side effects matli (nausea), ulti (vomiting), dast (diarrhea), pait dard aur jild par daane (skin rashes) hain.

blocks.long_description: Penicillin - A. Fleming, Penicillium fungi, Gram + bacteria, Cell wall; Tetracycline - B. M. Duggar, Streptomyces, Syphilis, Protein synthesis; Fluoroquinolones - George Lesher, Cinchona tree, Bacterial infections, DNA replication; Sulfonamides - Gerhard Domagk, Sulfanilamide compound, Bacterial infections, Inhibiting folate synthesis.

blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 23.1 mein penicillin ka target 'Cell membrane' chhapa hai, lekin kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke penicillin bacterial cell wall banna rokti hai (peptidoglycan ke jor); is liye yahan sahih 'Cell wall' likha hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Har column aik antibiotic ki kahani hai: kis ne daryaft ki (Discovery), kahan se aati hai (Source), kis bimari mein kaam aati hai (Reaction) aur bacteria ke kis hisse ko nishana banati hai (Targets). Fluoroquinolones ke saath 'Cinchona tree' is liye likha hai ke yeh chloroquine (quinine) ki tayyari se nikle aur quinine Cinchona ki chhaal se aati hai.
